mapper.sql: (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_deal_team team WHERE team.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND team.biz_type = 'QUOTE' AND team.biz_id = t.quote_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_contract contract JOIN crm_deal_team team ON team.tenant_id = contract.tenant_id AND team.biz_type = 'CONTRACT' AND team.biz_id = contract.contract_id WHERE contract.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND contract.source_type = 'CRM_QUOTE' AND contract.source_id = t.quote_id))
mapper.select: SELECT contract_id, customer_id, contract_no, currency FROM oa_contract WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND source_type = 'CRM_QUOTE' AND source_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR SHARE

SELECT contract.contract_id FROM oa_contract contract JOIN crm_deal_team team ON team.tenant_id = contract.tenant_id AND team.biz_type = 'CONTRACT' AND team.biz_id = contract.contract_id WHERE contract.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND contract.source_type = 'CRM_QUOTE' AND contract.source_id = #{id} FOR SHARE
SELECT * FROM crm_quote WHERE quote_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT quote.*, customer.dept_id AS scope_dept_id, customer.owner_id AS scope_owner_id FROM crm_quote quote JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = quote.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = quote.tenant_id AND customer.deleted = 0 WHERE quote.quote_id = #{id} AND quote.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND quote.deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.quote_id, t.tenant_id, t.instance_id, t.quote_no, t.customer_id, t.customer_name, t.opportunity_id, t.opportunity_name, t.quote_name, t.total_amount, t.tax_amount, t.currency, t.version, AS currency_locked, t.valid_until, t.owner_id, t.owner_name, t.contract_id, t.contract_no, t.attachment_url, t.remark, t.status, t.deleted, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, c.dept_id AS scope_dept_id, c.owner_id AS scope_owner_id FROM crm_quote t INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id AND c.deleted = '0' WHERE t.quote_id = #{quoteId} AND t.deleted = '0'
